states.name: mobile-menu

expect.note: Mobile menu frame 4816:15071 (375px): the 10-row list is the same 48px sidebar-list-item with the first row Active (#E8F0FB). Design question, not pinned: the frame sets the icon rows to padding 12px 16px (icon at 16px) where Desktop pads 12px 16px 12px 24px, draws no stroke or radius, and its first "Heading" is a plain 16/24 text layer (4816:15208), not a group heading. The sidebar-list-item set has only State variants, so the 16px reads as an instance override, and the component has no mobile mode.
Rows of the second section have no leading icon, so they pad 24px on the left (4816:15214).
4816:15211 pads 24px inline, 20px under the separator; the label is Desktop/Body/Small 500 in #757575 (4816:15213).
